parsed.explanation: The write-up proves an invariant only when Xiang splits every length-2d segment exactly once. For other cut allocations, it gives examples and says they “seem” to yield at least as much, but supplies no all-n argument. Thus it does not establish a universal lower bound against every Xiang reply, as required by L3.3. Moreover, the proposed target (n+1)/(2n+1) is not the correct general value.
